title: Mini multi-relationship domain
summary: Blog domain: bloggers, posts (1:N), tags, post_tags (M:N).
description: Blog domain: bloggers, posts (1:N), tags, post_tags (M:N).
starterCodePrisma:
model LabBlogger {
  id Int @id @default(autoincrement())
  handle String @unique
  posts LabPost[]
  @@map("lab_bloggers")
}
model LabPost {
  id Int @id @default(autoincrement())
  title String
  bloggerId Int @map("blogger_id")
  blogger LabBlogger @relation(fields: [bloggerId], references: [id])
  tags LabPostTag[]
  @@map("lab_posts")
}
model LabTag {
  id Int @id @default(autoincrement())
  label String @unique
  posts LabPostTag[]
  @@map("lab_tags")
}
model LabPostTag {
  postId Int @map("post_id")
  tagId Int @map("tag_id")
  post LabPost @relation(fields: [postId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tag LabTag @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([postId, tagId])
  @@map("lab_post_tags")
}
